model.name: CR #86-3: Set-as-Current demotes the previous current to NEXT (single-focus, demotion-intent input)
model.reason: Tron literal: 'when i set Task 40.1 as Set as Current, i WANT the current task 37.25 SET AS NEXT.' A guarantee delivered ALWAYS, not a build-order coincidence.
model.tronDirective: #86 (Tron 2026-08-20): T40.1 decline minted CR 4babebb1 but produced NO ACTION; CR hung off the Task not the Test; 'processing change requests' grep=0 (never built).
model.realtime: META-realtime: the mutation MUST emit ViewBus.notify(viewBusKey({type,uuid})) on the ONE VIEW BUS (v0.8.116 live-bridge) for every affected unit so the GUI re-renders IN-PLACE, no reload — gated by the live-MVC standard (ViewBus callback, not poll/reload).

acceptanceCriteria.text: setAsCurrent(T) is atomic: set focus on T AND CLEAR focus on ALL other in-sprint tasks. INV-single-focus: <=1 designation per sprint.

The displaced previous-current is recorded in ONE demotion-intent INPUT field (nextHint/demotedFromCurrent), written ONLY by the set-current handler; it is an input, never a cached 'next' value; clears deterministically.
next = DERIVED from (designation + demotion-intent + taskNumber order): the intent, when present+valid, places the demoted task in the next slot; else next = first not-past by taskNumber asc.

A stored 'current' representation (name/taskName) OR a cached derived 'next' VALUE holding a task different from the designation -> RED. Only INPUTS are stored (designation + demotion-intent); derived facts (current/next/name/taskName/status) are never stored.
setAsCurrent emits ViewBus.notify(CurrentSprint singleton) -> pin re-renders live (R40.17 live-pin), no reload.
